actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Burning Hands (1st-Level Spell; 2/Day)
actions.desc: You shoot forth a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in that area must make a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 10 (3d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried.

actions.name: Fire Bolt (Cantrip)
actions.desc: Ranged Spell Attack: Ranged Spell Attack: +3 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d10) fire damage. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
You cast one of the following wizard spells (spell save DC 11), using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]]
- **2/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Grease|grease]]

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Sacred Flame (Cantrip)
actions.desc: You target one creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a DC 11 Dexterity saving throw or take 4 (1d8) radiant damage. The target gains no benefit from cover for this saving throw.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
You cast one the following cleric spells (spell save DC 11), using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]]
- **2/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]]

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) slashing damage, or 6 (1d10 + 1) slashing damage if used with two hands.

bonus_actions.name: Shove
bonus_actions.desc: While wielding a shield, you try to shove one creature within 5 feet of you.
